findings.text: an allowlisted verb's tail is never inspected, so a writing option is forwarded and the shim writes where a mutating verb would be refused: `git -C <other> log --oneline --output=<other>/ESCAPE-log.txt` exits 0 and writes 29 bytes into the other checkout, `show --output` writes 118 bytes, and `--output=<home>/ESCAPE-home.txt` writes into the home directory, which the fence leaves writable outside the paths it names (reckon/_backends.py:2026-2039) — the module's own rule at lines 61-63 keeps fsck out for exactly this reason.

a read-only verb aimed at another checkout is forwarded with no target check, and status rewrites that repository's index: one forwarded `git -C <other> status --porcelain` moved the index sha256 from 492366fbf530a668 to 0517aa22a63d96a9 under a stale stat cache, so the claim at line 454 that nothing was changed and that status passes everywhere does not hold for a verb that refreshes the index it reads.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base 7f97afda; the new shim module, its entry script, the dispatch PATH change and the two test files are all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the measure's arms are each reproduced — the named suite passes at the reviewed head (15 passed in 6.93s, tests/test_git_shim_checks_the_resolved_repo.py), the same verb inside the worktree succeeds, no run id leaves the shim transparent, and a plain -C <other> is refused; the arm reading read-only verbs pass everywhere is measured false (finding 2).
item_verdicts.goal: read the followup f-awcwyh-git-shim-checks-the-resolved-repo and the landed module; the shim re-decides at execution time from the repository the invocation resolves to rather than from the command text, and the refusal fires on a mutating verb against another checkout (probe C1: exit 97, other HEAD 53f1c71e unchanged).
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the gate commands with their results, fourteen log paths, the negative controls and the two prior review rounds; its gate head 4aa785dc is docs-only-equal to the reviewed head a370c5be.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest's declared paths were compared with the diff's file set; 24 files on each side, equal, nothing outside the declared scope.

justifications.durability: each landed gap has a test that drives the real shim through a shell and is red before its fix (tests/test_git_shim_checks_the_resolved_repo.py:162, :339, :370, :404), and each fails on the reinstated bypass.
justifications.evidence: the gate reproduces at the reviewed head and carries a red-at-base arm, but no arm probes a writing option on an allowlisted verb, which is where the write escapes.
justifications.fit: reckon/worker_git_shim.py:1-31 explains the mechanism and the reason for an allowlist, and the new names carry no plan, sprint or version label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/worker_git_shim.py:287 returns an allowlisted verb as read-only without reading its tail, so the target probe never runs for it and the write at an option is forwarded.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff's 24 paths equal the manifest's declared set exactly, so nothing outside the declared write paths was touched.
